note: FUEL-02: the single home for liquid-fuel densities. Blend density is the volume-weighted sum of component densities at the blend's reference temperature (ideal mixing; measured glow blends sit within about 2 %). Sources and numbers: docs/research/fuel-systems/FUEL-00/README.md section 6.1.

density.source: https://doi.org/10.2514/6.2016-5011, Table 1, 25 degC; the value the glow profiles use (ISED table: 786.7 at 25 degC, 791.4 at 20 degC)

density_slope.source: Measurement Canada methanol volume-correction table (CAS 67-56-1), 15-25 degC; FUEL-00 ISED-MEOH

density_slope.source: Measurement Canada gasoline/ethanol-blend volume-correction table (to E15); FUEL-00 ISED-GAS

glow_10n_18castor.name: glow fuel, 10 % nitromethane, 18 % castor oil by volume

gasoline_premix_40_1.name: gasoline with two-stroke oil, 40:1 by volume
